summary.ru: Нейстрия — историческая область на северо-западе франкского королевства Меровингов со столицей сначала в Суассоне, потом в Париже.
summary.en: Neustria was the western part of the Kingdom of the Franks during the Early Middle Ages, in contrast to the eastern Frankish sub-kingdom, Austrasia. It initially included land between the Loire and the Silva Carbonaria, in the north of present-day France, with Paris, Orléans, Tours, Soissons as its main cities.
